title: Palisade Asset Management LLC Sells 391 Shares of Apple Inc. (AAPL)
text:
Tweet
Palisade Asset Management LLC reduced its holdings in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 0.4% during the 3rd quarter, HoldingsChannel reports. The fund owned 91,084 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 391 shares during the period. Apple accounts for about 2.7% of Palisade Asset Management LLC’s portfolio, making the stock its 6th largest position. Palisade Asset Management LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $20,561,000 as of its most recent filing with the SEC.
Several other institutional investors have also modified their holdings of AAPL. Delphi Private Advisors LLC acquired a new position in Apple in the second quarter valued at about $120,000. CX Institutional acquired a new position in Apple in the second quarter valued at about $135,000. Selective Wealth Management acquired a new position in Apple in the third quarter valued at about $194,000. Lawson Kroeker Investment Management Inc. NE bought a new position in shares of Apple in the third quarter worth about $201,000. Finally, Boston Standard Wealth Management LLC bought a new position in shares of Apple in the third quarter worth about $204,000. Institutional investors and hedge funds own 57.05% of the company’s stock. Get Apple alerts:
A number of equities analysts have weighed in on AAPL shares. JPMorgan Chase & Co. reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $228.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, January 11th. Royal Bank of Canada reaffirmed a “buy” rating and issued a $185.00 target price on shares of Apple in a research note on Friday, January 18th. Citigroup reduced their price target on shares of Apple from $265.00 to $240.00 and set a “buy” rating for the company in a report on Friday, November 2nd. Rosenblatt Securities set a $165.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the company a “neutral” rating in a report on Thursday, December 6th. Finally, Morgan Stanley upped their price target on shares of Apple from $226.00 to $253.00 and gave the company an “overweight” rating in a report on Thursday, November 8th. Three research analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-four have given a hold rating and twenty-two have given a buy rating to the company. The stock has a consensus rating of “Hold” and an average target price of $195.33. In other Apple news, insider Chris Kondo sold 3,408 shares of the company’s stock in a transaction on Monday, November 19th. The shares were sold at an average price of $190.00, for a total transaction of $647,520.00. Following the sale, the insider now directly owns 8,940 shares of the company’s stock, valued at $1,698,600. The transaction was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which is accessible through this hyperlink . Corporate insiders own 0.05% of the company’s stock.
NASDAQ AAPL opened at $152.70 on Friday. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a current ratio of 1.12. Apple Inc. has a 1 year low of $142.00 and a 1 year high of $233.47. The firm has a market cap of $753.49 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 12.82, a PEG ratio of 1.48 and a beta of 1.23.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last posted its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share (EPS) for the quarter, topping the Thomson Reuters’ consensus estimate of $2.78 by $0.13. Apple had a net margin of 22.41% and a return on equity of 48.68%. The firm had revenue of $62.90 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $61.55 billion. During the same period in the prior year, the firm posted $2.07 earnings per share. The company’s quarterly revenue was up 19.6% compared to the same quarter last year. Apple Company Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
